config.classes_note: Five classes, each the census's own intersection, evidence kind, negative tag or stated limit for the entity, stated by field sources at the loci given: (1) labor performed with AI, delegation, collaboration mode and task completion (intersection 'labor-with-ai'; B11 Chapter 2, B12 footnotes, B2 abstract, B13); (2) AI exposure of occupations and tasks (evidence_kind 'exposure estimate'; B12, B13); (3) a provider's interaction data on its own product (evidence_kind 'interaction data', negative_tags[0]; B11, B12, B2); (4) productivity gains and who receives them (intersection 'gains-and-losses', direction.gains; B11 Chapter 4, B12); (5) a model's assessment of its own output, task success as the model assesses it (negative_tags[2] and [4], stated_limits[0]; B11 Chapter 2 and Introduction, B12 footnote 02). The archive's instruments of labor direction bear on class (1): Directionality of Semantic Labor (#771, with its definition surface #1392), its directionality stack DS-6 and its operators task-origin and User Labor Drag (#771 §§ abstract, 8), where they measure whether a synthetic system's labor advanced the task its user commissioned; the census's lv_intersection names that meeting as the archive's reading. The archive's self-audit work bears on class (5): the Self-Audit Module for public summarizers (#780, v3 #156) and its anti-self-flattery principle, where it states what a model's score of its own output returns without ground truth it does not control. The semantic-labor line bears on class (4) where a deposit states who captures the value of labor performed with or for a model. The aliases are the entity's names in the field and the census (Anthropic Economic Index; Economic Index report / Survey; Anthropic AI Usage Index; the Hugging Face dataset id; the arXiv numbers of the second and third reports). 'AEI' is not an alias (ambiguous). 'Clio' is Anthropic's privacy-preserving analysis system, a separate entity the reports use. Admission by reading (§3.4): D where a deposit names the entity and says something of it; O-class where a sentence applies an archive category to a class above; a bare mention, a list or a reference line is not a claim.
